## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `pytest` passes

- [ ] Numerical results unchanged, or the differences are explained (`validation/compare.py`)
- [ ] Departures from the published articles are stated here and in the documentation
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` updated; generated files rebuilt (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No confidential or production measurement data included
